clauses.name: Exile
clauses.printedParagraph: Exile a target manifestation on the field or in a Limbo.

clauses.name: Carcass Devourer
clauses.printedParagraph: When Carcass Devourer enters the field, you may exile up to two target manifestations from your Limbo. If you do, add their base power to Carcass Devourer's power.

clauses.name: Referen-Doom, the Dreamer
clauses.printedParagraph: When Referen-Doom enters the field, you may Exile any number of target Wills from your Limbo. Referen-Doom gets +1 power for each Will Exiled this way until the end of the turn.

clauses.name: Horned Augustus
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as it is on the field, during the confrontation you may Exhaust the Horned Augustus: Exile up to 3 target cards from your Limbo. Put in Support under you control a Token with 1 🔥 power for each card exiled this way.

clauses.name: Everspring
clauses.printedParagraph: Remove 3 Tear counters: Exile up to 3 target manifestations in the Empathic Vessel of an opponent for a maximum total value of 60 points.

clauses.name: Shattered Memory
clauses.printedParagraph: Exhaust this card: Exile a target card in a player's Limbo.

clauses.name: Shattered Memory
clauses.printedParagraph: Exile this card: You gain 1 🌈 essence.

clauses.name: Subjugate
clauses.printedParagraph: You may pay up to 4 extra 🔘 essences to play this Will.

clauses.name: Subjugate
clauses.printedParagraph: Exile a target Manifestation on the field with a Point value equal to or less than the number of essences used as tribute multiplied by 10. (e.g., 2 essences = 20, 3 essences = 30)
